full_judgment: 2. The pre-emptor-respondent No.1 filed Misc. Case No. 18 and 19 of 1992 under Section 96 of the State. Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-empting the case land stating that he is a co-sharer of the holding transferred and the purchaser pre-emptee is a stranger to the holding. The trial court on contest allowed the cases. Pre-emptee filed Misc. Appeal Nos. 200 and 201 of 1992 against the judgment and order of the trial court. During pendency of the said appeal the pre-emptees filed applications for recording abatement of the case on the ground of non-substitution of the heirs of opposite-party Nos. 20 and 21. The lower appellate court rejected the applications holding that no substitution of heirs of non-contesting opposite-parties is necessary and for want of substitution the cases proceedings did not abate. Against that orders of pre-emptees moved the High Court Division in revision and obtained the Rule in Civil Revision Nos. 4341 and 4342 of 1998.
